# Create a numpy array to store the values of the goods for each person
goods = np.array([[40, 2, 3, 25, 30],
                   [14, 26, 8, 26, 26],

# Create a numpy array to store the allocation of the goods to each person
allocation = np.zeros(goods.shape, dtype=int)

# Iterate over the rows of the goods array (each row represents a person)
for i in range(goods.shape[0]):
    # Get the indices of the goods that are not yet allocated
    available_goods = np.where(allocation[i] == 0)[0]

    # Get the values of the available goods for the current person
    available_goods_values = goods[i][available_goods]

    # Get the index of the good with the maximum value
    max_value_index = np.argmax(available_goods_values)

    # Allocate the good with the maximum value to the current person
    allocation[i][available_goods[max_value_index]] = 1

print(f"Allocation:\n{allocation}")

# Calculate the Nash welfare, i.e. product of individual utilities
individual_utilities = np.array([np.prod(goods[i][allocation[i] == 1]) for i in range(goods.shape[0])])
nash_welfare = np.prod(individual_utilities)
print(f"Nash welfare: {nash_welfare}")
